* The use of tree-sitter for parsing source code and generating ASTs.
* The use of LLMs (Large Language Models) for generating AI-generated information.
* The use of FAISS (Facebook AI Similarity Search) for indexing the knowledge base.
* The use of a Python 3.10+ environment and pip for installation and execution.
